description: Effective capabilities per scope for one user and one region. Inputs: the document role, the region policy (`confidential` is ADR 0019, proposed), the region grants (principal, role, expiry in Unix milliseconds), the document state, whether a workflow is active, the region state and the holder of a lease. `now` is the server time of the computation. A region whose capabilities lack `view` is hidden from the user. `fill` says whether the connection may fill fields at all; which fields is 12 §4.
